name: Hunters
description: Individuals who hunt monsters for profit, vendetta or sport, mistrusted by civilized humans.

description_citations.text: "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Merrevia Sal crashes into a clearing and demands meat from a party of hunters.
timeline.quote: I am Merrevia Sal. Give me the meat, or I will kill you.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Hunters work together to net and kill Merrevia Sal while Nicol, pinned, wants to help but Ugin holds him back.
timeline.quote: Yet still she struggles, still she fights because she is a dragon, and dragons never bow before lesser creatures.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien and Chevill's hunters prepare an ambush with buried explosives in a canyon, expecting Lukka.
timeline.quote: she and Chevill were the only thing standing between those people and their doom.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The titan triggers buried mines and plunges its leg into lava, and Chevill's hunters attack with poisoned arrows and spears.
timeline.quote: They loosed a stinging cloud of arrows, peppering the Lukka-thing's flank

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vivien's first arrow is blocked by bone, and the titan tears free of the hunters' ropes and kills many of them.
timeline.quote: with a sweep of one misshapen arm, the giant cleared them from the scrubland

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

relations.note: Nicol wants to burn them in vengeance

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

relations.quote: leaving her alone with the man they called their leader
